rules.quote: `MEMORY.md` is the one-line index — scan it first.
rules.rule: Before other work, scan the MEMORY.md index file in the memory directory.

rules.quote: After fixing a non-obvious bug
rules.rule: After fixing a non-obvious bug (one whose surprise came from invisible behavior rather than a visible syntax error), record it as a memory entry.

rules.quote: Add `feedback_<short-slug>.md` here with the rule + Why + How to apply.
rules.rule: When adding a memory entry, create a feedback_<short-slug>.md file in the memory directory containing the rule, its Why, and its How to apply.

rules.quote: Add a one-line pointer at the bottom of `MEMORY.md`.
rules.rule: When adding a memory entry, add a one-line pointer to it at the bottom of MEMORY.md.

rules.quote: Commit + push.
rules.rule: After adding a memory entry, commit and push the change.

rules.quote: Keep entries terse — one screen each.
rules.rule: Keep each memory entry terse, no longer than one screen.

rules.quote: If you edit files here, also update your personal copy
rules.rule: When editing a shared memory file, also update your personal copy of it, and when editing a personal copy, also update the shared copy.

rules.quote: Never instruct the user to "select all and reindex" on Index Management — it won't work.
rules.rule: Never instruct the user to select all and reindex on the Index Management page, because the row checkboxes are hidden and the mass action won't work.

rules.quote: When a feature needs flat reindex / cache flush, wire a dedicated POST controller action that runs
rules.rule: When a feature needs a flat reindex or cache flush, implement a dedicated POST controller action to perform it rather than relying on mass actions.

rules.quote: Surface it as a button on whatever admin page the feature lives on — don't send the user to Index Management.
rules.rule: Surface the reindex or cache flush action as a button on the admin page where the feature lives, and do not direct the user to Index Management.

rules.quote: First thing to check when localhost or live returns 500 on all routes is whether Apache mod_headers is loaded
rules.rule: When localhost or the live site returns HTTP 500 on all routes, check first whether Apache mod_headers is loaded.

rules.quote: run the recovery one-liner above
rules.rule: If the logs show "Invalid command 'Header'", re-enable the missing Apache modules by running `docker exec ai-mms-web-1 a2enmod headers expires brotli rewrite deflate && docker exec ai-mms-web-1 apachectl -k graceful`.

rules.quote: ensure `docker/entrypoint.sh` still contains the `a2enmod headers expires brotli rewrite deflate` line before the migration block.
rules.rule: Ensure `docker/entrypoint.sh` still contains the `a2enmod headers expires brotli rewrite deflate` line before the migration block.

rules.quote: always run in this order:
rules.rule: When diagnosing a site 500 error, run the diagnostic checklist steps in the specified order.

rules.quote: `curl -sS -o /tmp/h.html -w "HTTP=%{http_code}\n" -L http://localhost:8080/` — confirm 500
rules.rule: When diagnosing a site 500 error, first confirm the 500 status with `curl -sS -o /tmp/h.html -w "HTTP=%{http_code}\n" -L http://localhost:8080/`.

rules.quote: `docker logs --tail 30 ai-mms-web-1` — look for `Invalid command 'Header'`
rules.rule: When diagnosing a site 500 error, check `docker logs --tail 30 ai-mms-web-1` for the message "Invalid command 'Header'".

rules.quote: Only after ruling out (2) should you look at `var/report/` for Magento-level fatals
rules.rule: Only look at `var/report/` for Magento-level fatals after ruling out the missing mod_headers cause.

rules.quote: no line *inside the value* may end with `;`
rules.rule: When writing a multi-line string value in a migration .sql file, never let any line inside the value end with a semicolon, because migrations/apply.php would split the statement there.

rules.quote:
emit each value line so it ends with a tag (`>`) or a quote (`'`), never a bare
`;`
rules.rule: When generating data migrations with multi-line text values, end each value line with a tag (`>`) or a quote (`'`), never with a bare semicolon.

rules.quote:
Verify before applying:
`grep -nE ';\s*$' migrations/NNN.sql`
rules.rule: Before applying a migration, run `grep -nE ';\s*$' migrations/NNN.sql` and confirm every hit is a real statement terminator.

rules.quote: guard content-rewrite UPDATEs with `MD5(value) = '<oldhash>'`
rules.rule: Guard content-rewrite UPDATE statements in migrations with a `MD5(value) = '<oldhash>'` condition so they are idempotent and skip rows edited after the migration was generated.

rules.quote: always write a SQL migration script
rules.rule: When local and remote databases diverge in this project, always write a SQL migration script to bring them into line.

rules.quote: Never propose dump-and-restore, direct replication, or other whole-DB sync methods.
rules.rule: Never propose dump-and-restore, direct replication, or other whole-database sync methods to reconcile local and remote databases in this project.

rules.quote: skip straight to drafting the migration SQL
rules.rule: When the user reports local/remote DB drift or asks to "sync" databases, skip straight to drafting the migration SQL.

rules.quote: Ask what the *target state* should be
rules.rule: Before drafting a DB sync migration, ask the user what the target state should be (which fields/rows differ and which side is canonical).

rules.quote: write an idempotent script that applies just those changes
rules.rule: Write the DB migration script as idempotent and limited to applying only the agreed changes.

rules.quote: Place under `migrations/` for production-bound scripts
rules.rule: Place production-bound DB migration scripts under `migrations/`.

rules.quote: or `scripts/local-dev/` for local-only fixups
rules.rule: Place local-only DB fixup scripts under `scripts/local-dev/`.

rules.quote: The EAV migration is necessary but NOT sufficient.
rules.rule: When asked to add, remove, or modify a field that admins see on the "Edit Course" page, do not treat an EAV migration alone as sufficient.

rules.quote:
Add a `
…
` to the appropriate `dcf-tab-panel`
rules.rule:
When adding a field to the "Edit Course" page, add a `
…
` to the appropriate `dcf-tab-panel` in `dashboard/index.phtml`.

rules.quote: search for nearby fields like `name="training_hours"` or `name="course_type_select"` to find the right tab
rules.rule: When determining where to place a new field in `dashboard/index.phtml`, search for nearby fields such as `name="training_hours"` or `name="course_type_select"` to find the right tab.

rules.quote: Add a corresponding `if (($v = $req->getParam('<field>')) !== null)
rules.rule: When adding a field to the "Edit Course" page, add a corresponding `if (($v = $req->getParam('<field>')) !== null) $product->setData('<field>', …)` line in `saveAction()` of `CoursesaveController.php`.

rules.quote: you **must** set `source_model='eav/entity_attribute_source_table'` on the `eav_attribute` row
rules.rule: When adding a multiselect EAV product attribute on catalog_product, set source_model='eav/entity_attribute_source_table' on the eav_attribute row.

rules.quote: Any new multiselect (or `select` w/ admin-managed options) EAV migration in this repo must include in the `INSERT INTO eav_attribute`:
rules.rule: Any new multiselect (or select with admin-managed options) EAV migration in this repo must include backend_model='eav/entity_attribute_backend_array' and source_model='eav/entity_attribute_source_table' in the INSERT INTO eav_attribute statement.

rules.quote: See [[funding-badges-via-tags]] for the alternative (tag-based) path that avoids EAV entirely when the values are also storefront-filterable.
rules.rule: When the values are also storefront-filterable, consider the tag-based path (see funding-badges-via-tags) instead of creating an EAV attribute.

rules.quote: Always reindex `catalog_product_flat`
rules.rule: After a bulk catalog attribute write, always reindex catalog_product_flat (including every per-store flat table catalog_product_flat_<store_id>).

rules.quote: flush `block_html` + `full_page` + `collections` after the write
rules.rule: After a bulk catalog attribute write, flush the block_html, full_page, and collections caches.

rules.quote: **never use a `Host: tertiarycourses.com.<tld>` header against localhost**
rules.rule: When verifying locally with curl, never send a Host header of tertiarycourses.com.<tld> against localhost.

rules.quote: Hit `http://localhost:8080/<url-key>.html` directly
rules.rule: When verifying a storefront page locally with curl, request http://localhost:8080/<url-key>.html directly.

rules.quote: for a specific store view set `MAGE_RUN_CODE` via query string or env, not via Host header.
rules.rule: To verify a specific store view locally, set MAGE_RUN_CODE via query string or environment variable, never via the Host header.

rules.quote: Before running the bulk write, scan for existing per-store overrides on the same attribute and either merge them or document why they're being clobbered.
rules.rule: Before running a bulk attribute write, scan for existing per-store overrides on that attribute and either merge them or document why they are being clobbered.

rules.quote: `$product->setStoreId(0)->saveAttribute(...)` — but resource model may still write to current store; safer is the direct SQL path below.
rules.rule: Do not rely on setStoreId(0)->saveAttribute() to write at admin scope; prefer the direct SQL write at store_id=0.

rules.quote: For bulk catalog migrations that should affect every country, do NOT rely on `saveAttribute()` from a CLI default app context.
rules.rule: For bulk catalog migrations that should affect every country, do not rely on saveAttribute() from a CLI default app context.

rules.quote: call `Mage::getResourceSingleton('catalog/product_flat_indexer')->updateProduct($id, $storeId)` per store
rules.rule: When saving a product attribute from a controller in this codebase, call updateProduct on the catalog/product_flat_indexer resource singleton for the product ID and each store.

rules.quote: then `Mage::app()->cleanCache(['catalog_product_' . $id])`
rules.rule: After reindexing a single product's flat catalog entries, call Mage::app()->cleanCache with the catalog_product_<id> tag for that product.

rules.quote: prefer one whole-index reindex via `Mage::getModel('index/process')->load('catalog_product_flat', 'indexer_code')->reindexEverything()` at the end
rules.rule: For batch attribute operations, prefer a single reindexEverything() call on the catalog_product_flat index process at the end rather than per-product reindexing.

rules.quote: plus `cleanType('block_html')`
rules.rule: For batch attribute operations, flush the block_html cache type after the reindex.

rules.quote: `cleanType('full_page')`
rules.rule: For batch attribute operations, flush the full_page cache type after the reindex.

rules.quote: `cleanType('collections')`
rules.rule: For batch attribute operations, flush the collections cache type after the reindex.

rules.quote: reindex via direct UPDATEs from `catalog_product_entity_<type>` into each `catalog_product_flat_<store_id>`
rules.rule: In SQL migrations under migrations/*.sql, reindex the flat catalog by running direct UPDATEs from catalog_product_entity_<type> into each catalog_product_flat_<store_id> table, since no PHP hook runs during deploy.

rules.quote: `TRUNCATE TABLE core_cache_tag` at the end
rules.rule: At the end of a SQL migration under migrations/*.sql, truncate the core_cache_tag table to force block_html and full-page cache regeneration.

rules.quote: append the name to `Helper/Data.php::getAllBadges()`
rules.rule: When adding a new funding badge, append its name to getAllBadges() in Helper/Data.php.

rules.quote: add a `course-badge--<key>` CSS class
rules.rule: When adding a new funding badge, add a course-badge--<key> CSS class for it in skin/frontend/ultimo/default/css/custom.css.

rules.quote: add a row to the `getBadgeCssClass()` map
rules.rule: When adding a new funding badge, add a row for it to the getBadgeCssClass() map.

rules.quote: seed a `tag` row via a new migration
rules.rule: When adding a new funding badge, seed a tag row for it via a new migration.

rules.quote: Do NOT add a column to the EAV.
rules.rule: Never add a column to the EAV (product attribute tables) for funding badges.

rules.quote: they come from `tag_relation`, not from a product attribute
rules.rule: When asked where funding badges come from, answer that they come from tag_relation, not from a product attribute.

rules.quote: After any direct DB tag write, reindex `catalog_product_flat`
rules.rule: After any direct database tag write, reindex catalog_product_flat.

rules.quote: flush `block_html`/FPC
rules.rule: After any direct database tag write, flush the block_html and FPC caches.

rules.quote: do NOT short-circuit emission based on local's current state
rules.rule: When a migration generator reads from the local DB to produce prod-bound SQL, do not skip emitting statements based on the local DB's current state.

rules.quote: ALWAYS emit unconditional strip statements (UPDATE / REPLACE)
rules.rule: When building a prod-bound generator from local data, always emit unconditional strip statements (UPDATE / REPLACE).

rules.quote: let idempotency come from `REPLACE()` being a no-op on rows that don't contain the substring, not from a generator-side check that depends on local state
rules.rule: Rely on REPLACE() being a no-op for rows that don't contain the substring to provide idempotency, not on a generator-side check that depends on local state.

rules.quote: let the SQL be self-idempotent rather than skipping emission
rules.rule: Make INSERT ... WHERE NOT EXISTS and UPDATE ... WHERE NOT LIKE guards self-idempotent in the SQL rather than skipping emission in the generator.

rules.quote: For any `REPLACE()` whose search string contains `\r`, `\n`, `\\`, or escaped quotes, prefer `REPLACE(value, UNHEX('<bin2hex of bytes>'), '')` over the string-literal form.
rules.rule: For any REPLACE() whose search string contains \r, \n, \\, or escaped quotes, prefer REPLACE(value, UNHEX('<bin2hex of bytes>'), '') over the string-literal form.

rules.quote: Verify generators that produce SQL from `media/migrations-reports/` backup payloads the same way: re-run the diagnostic against prod's rendered HTML
rules.rule: When verifying generators that produce SQL from media/migrations-reports/ backup payloads, re-run the diagnostic against prod's rendered HTML.

rules.quote: binary mode read — Python text mode strips `\r\n` to `\n` and creates a false positive that the substring matches
rules.rule: When reading prod's rendered HTML to check for substrings, read it in binary mode, not Python text mode.

rules.quote:
the mobile hide rule for the bottom
tabs section must be scoped to a **direct child** of `.product-view`,
not every `.box-additional`.
rules.rule: On the product (course) page, scope the mobile hide rule for the bottom tabs section to a direct child of `.product-view`, not to every `.box-additional`.

rules.quote: always use the direct-child combinator:
rules.rule: When adding or editing mobile hide rules for the bottom tabs wrapper on the product page, always use the direct-child combinator (`.product-view > .box-additional`).

rules.quote:
NOT:

```css
.catalog-product-view .box-additional { display: none !important; }  /* WRONG */
rules.rule: Never use an unqualified `.catalog-product-view .box-additional { display: none !important; }` selector for mobile hide rules on the product page.

rules.quote: never delete it.
rules.rule: Never delete the regex extraction fallback in view.phtml; keep it as a permanent safety net for the storefront section content.

rules.quote: feed it the RAW inner HTML
rules.rule: When passing WSQ Funding content to the WSQ post-processor, pass the raw inner HTML of the section.

rules.quote: WSQ Funding cms/block content is the SFC/UTAP/PSEA narrative ONLY.
rules.rule: Put only the SFC/UTAP/PSEA narrative in the WSQ Funding cms/block content.

rules.quote: never enter fee tables or amounts in the block.
rules.rule: Never enter WSQ course fee tables or fee amounts in the WSQ Funding cms/block content; those are calculated automatically from the product price.

rules.quote: append to `$_cmsPanels` (dashboard/index.phtml), `$_cmsSections` (CoursesaveController)
rules.rule: When adding a new course section, append it to `$_cmsPanels` in dashboard/index.phtml and to `$_cmsSections` in CoursesaveController.

rules.quote: add a `$_courseSectionHtml('newcode')` call site in view.phtml
rules.rule: When adding a new course section, add a `$_courseSectionHtml('newcode')` call site in view.phtml.

rules.quote: Naming `course_<sku>_<newcode>`.
rules.rule: Name the cms/block identifier for a new course section `course_<sku>_<newcode>`.

rules.quote: DO NOT seed templated content (e.g. "standard WSQ narrative") into blocks.
rules.rule: Do not seed templated content such as a standard WSQ narrative into cms/block rows.

rules.quote: DO NOT modify `short_description` content.
rules.rule: Do not modify the content of a product's short_description.

rules.quote: if anyone re-adds one, refuse it
rules.rule: If anyone asks to re-add a script that strips section headings from short_description, refuse it.

rules.quote: double-check every variable the new section reads is computed *above* the insertion point in the same file
rules.rule: When inserting a new conditional section into an OpenMage phtml template, verify that every variable the new section reads is computed above the insertion point in the same file.

rules.quote: grep the file for every variable referenced in the new block
rules.rule: Before pushing a phtml change that gates a new section on PHP variables, grep the file for every variable referenced in the new block.

rules.quote: confirm each one is assigned earlier in the same template
rules.rule: Before pushing a phtml change that gates a new section on PHP variables, confirm that each variable referenced in the new block is assigned earlier in the same template.

rules.quote: hoist it to a guaranteed-reached prelude
rules.rule: If a variable is assigned only inside a conditional that may not run on the current page, hoist its computation to a guaranteed-reached prelude before its first consumer.

rules.quote: never trust `$item->getProduct()->getData($attr)`
rules.rule: When you need a custom product attribute in a cart, quote, or order context, do not rely on `$item->getProduct()->getData($attr)` alone.

rules.quote: `Mage::getResourceModel('catalog/product')->getAttributeRawValue($productId, $attrCode, Mage::app()->getStore())` — single-query, cheap, no full reload.
rules.rule: When you need a single custom product attribute in a cart, quote, or order context, read it with `Mage::getResourceModel('catalog/product')->getAttributeRawValue($productId, $attrCode, Mage::app()->getStore())`.

rules.quote: `Mage::getModel('catalog/product')->load($productId)` — heavy, only if you need multiple custom attrs.
rules.rule: Use `Mage::getModel('catalog/product')->load($productId)` to load a product only when you need multiple custom attributes, since it is heavy.

rules.quote: `getData()` first,
rules.rule: In the cart item template that renders the cover image, call `getData()` on the product first to read the custom attribute.

rules.quote: fall back to `getAttributeRawValue` if empty.
rules.rule: In the cart item template that renders the cover image, if the `getData()` value is empty, fall back to `getAttributeRawValue` to read the attribute.

rules.quote:
use a Unicode-aware
whitespace class — never bare `\s`
rules.rule: When scrubbing or matching catalog_product_entity_text content (short_description, description) with PCRE, use a Unicode-aware whitespace class and never bare `\s`.

rules.quote:
define a
whitespace token like
`$WS = '(?:\s| |\x{00A0}|\x{2007}|\x{202F})';`
rules.rule: When writing PCRE against EAV text columns, define a whitespace token like `$WS = '(?:\s| |\x{00A0}|\x{2007}|\x{202F})';`.

rules.quote:
use it with
the `/u` (Unicode) modifier in every place you'd normally write `\s*`
or `\s+`
rules.rule: Use the whitespace token together with the `/u` modifier in every place where you would normally write `\s*` or `\s+`.

rules.quote:
Also widen the title alternative if the section name may
have been pasted with Unicode dashes or curly quotes.
rules.rule: When the section name in a title alternative may have been pasted with Unicode dashes or curly quotes, widen the title alternative to match them.

rules.quote:
After running,
verify by re-querying for the literal marker text
rules.rule: After running a scrubbing regex, verify by re-querying for the literal marker text.

rules.quote:
if any row still
contains the section header markup, suspect another invisible
codepoint and hex-dump the offending region
rules.rule: If any row still contains the section header markup after running the regex, suspect another invisible codepoint and hex-dump the offending region.

rules.quote: To make a custom email template **manageable in the admin** (System → Transactional Emails grid), registering a `<global><template><email>` file template in config.xml is NOT enough.
rules.rule: To make a custom email template manageable in the admin Transactional Emails grid, do not rely solely on registering a file template in config.xml; also seed a core_email_template database row.

rules.quote: Ship the file default: `app/locale/en_US/template/email/<module>/<name>.html` with `<!--@subject-->` / `<!--@vars-->` headers, registered in config.xml `<global><template><email>`.
rules.rule: When adding a transactional email the client must be able to edit, ship a file default at app/locale/en_US/template/email/<module>/<name>.html with @subject and @vars headers and register it in config.xml under <global><template><email>.

rules.quote: Seed a `core_email_template` row in a migration — `template_text` = the file body with the `@subject`/`@vars` comment blocks **stripped** (Magento stores those in `template_subject` / `orig_template_variables`), `template_type` = 2 for HTML, `orig_template_code` = the registered file code.
rules.rule: Seed the core_email_template row in a migration, with template_text set to the file body with the @subject and @vars comment blocks stripped, template_type set to 2 for HTML, and orig_template_code set to the registered file code.

rules.quote: Point a config path (e.g. `<module>/<feature>/email_template`) at the seeded row's `template_id` via `core_config_data` in the **same** migration (`SET @tid := (SELECT ... )` then INSERT). The sender reads that config path so edits to the DB row take effect.
rules.rule: In the same migration as the template seed, store the seeded row's template_id in a core_config_data config path (e.g. <module>/<feature>/email_template), so the sender reads it and edits to the DB row take effect.

rules.quote: `sendTransactional($templateId, ...)`: numeric id → loads the DB row; string code → loads the file default. Keep the string code as the `?:` fallback.
rules.rule: When calling sendTransactional, pass a numeric template id to load the DB row, and keep the string template code as the ?: fallback that loads the file default.

rules.quote: migration SQL with an inline HTML blob — the runner splits statements on `preg_split('/;\s*$/m')`, so ensure no HTML line ends with `;`
rules.rule: When writing migration SQL with an inline HTML blob, ensure no line of the HTML ends with a semicolon, because the runner splits statements on lines ending in semicolons.

rules.quote: Escape single quotes as `''`.
rules.rule: When writing migration SQL string literals containing single quotes, escape each single quote as two single quotes.

rules.quote: Before changing this rule, check which column is
rules.rule: Before changing the clear rule on `.product-view > .box-additional`, check which column is currently tallest on a representative product page.

rules.quote: If the right secondary column is dominant → `clear: none` (tabs rise
rules.rule: If the right secondary column is the tallest on the product page, set `clear: none` on `.product-view > .box-additional` so the tabs rise beside it.

rules.quote: If the left/image column is dominant → `clear: both`
rules.rule: If the left/image column is the tallest on the product page, set `clear: both` on `.product-view > .box-additional`.

rules.quote: Do NOT add `clear` to the inner columns themselves
rules.rule: Do not add a `clear` property to the inner columns (the `.grid12-4` img, primary, and secondary floats), because they must remain floated for the three-column layout.

rules.quote: always trigger selection via `checkbox.click()`
rules.rule: When injecting JS that selects rows in a Magento admin grid, select a row by calling `checkbox.click()` on its checkbox.

rules.quote: after checking `!checkbox.checked && !checkbox.disabled`
rules.rule: Before calling `checkbox.click()` to select a Magento admin grid row checkbox, first check that `!checkbox.checked && !checkbox.disabled` holds.

rules.quote: never via `checkbox.checked = true`
rules.rule: Never select a Magento admin grid row by setting `checkbox.checked = true`.

rules.quote: To unselect rows that are currently checked, also `.click()`
rules.rule: To unselect a Magento admin grid row that is currently checked, call `.click()` on its checkbox.

rules.quote: use `.click()`
rules.rule: When custom admin JS needs to programmatically tick grid checkboxes (per-row action injections, select-all toggles, delete-all buttons), use `.click()` on the checkboxes.

rules.quote: Same rule should govern any future grid-automation JS.
rules.rule: Apply the click-based checkbox selection rule to any future grid-automation JS.

rules.quote: Keep those names — the "Tertiary Courses Contact Form" email template resolves `{{var data.*}}` off them.
rules.rule: When editing the Contact Us form, keep the field names name, email, company, telephone, courses, course_code, and comment unchanged, because the "Tertiary Courses Contact Form" email template resolves variables from them.

rules.quote: To confirm which template is live: `curl /contacts/` and grep for a distinctive class (e.g. `tc-submit`).
rules.rule: To confirm which contact form template is live, request /contacts/ with curl and grep the response for a distinctive class such as tc-submit.
